discovery_notes: B394 follow-up 8 of B004 (DLR LE 2019). 30 standard searches. Prioritised uncovered pins from DPB weekly roundups (Jan-Dec 2019): mostly shared DLR/WDW releases keyed under wdw with dlr variant notes. Named gaps (Club 33 #2/#4/#5, Windows of Magic #8, Tape #2-#4) narrowed by date only; no holds released.
